text:
1. Time to heat up to 300 degrees: $20\text{ minutes}$
2. Time to heat from 300 to 400 degrees: $20 \times 1.40 = 28\text{ minutes}$
3. Total warming time: $20 + 28 = 48\text{ minutes}$
4. Cooking time: $48 - 5 = 43\text{ minutes}$
5. Total time from start to cooked chicken: $48 + 43 = 91\text{ minutes}$

ANSWER: 91
